row_grain: one row per batch - completed-batch summary, not a time series

process_stability_pct.note: mean of the three in_control_pct columns below, computed over valid_time_range

golden_batch_similarity_pct.note: mean of the three per-parameter similarity columns below, vs PAR-GOLDEN over the shared valid_time_range window

fault_onset_elapsed_minutes.note: first elapsed_minutes within valid_time_range where any of the 3 drying parameters left its band; NaN if none (Normal batches, or a fault that never crossed the band)

yield_pct.note: severity-tiered, seeded-hash, batch-level constant - no within-batch trajectory to predict from

quality_score_pct.note: temporary placeholder pending real batch_cqa_results (Quality Workbench Tier 3)

oee_availability_pct.note: uses FINAL batch_duration_minutes - not valid as a mid-batch prediction target without reformulation

oee_quality_pct.note: function of real process_stability_pct + seeded noise, but computed once at the end

total_energy_kwh.note: uses FINAL batch_duration_minutes - same caveat as oee_availability_pct

sec_kwh_per_kg.note: total_energy_kwh / output_kg, output_kg derived from synthetic yield_pct

prediction_readiness_note: This dataset is an end-of-batch summary only - no forecasting labels or rolling/cumulative KPI trajectories are built here. Columns marked has_temporal_signal=true are the ones a future KPI-deterioration-prediction effort could plausibly reshape into a time series (their per-parameter sub-components are stored here specifically to avoid recomputation later); columns marked false are either batch-level constants with no within-batch trajectory (synthetic fields) or derived from a value (final duration) that is only known once the batch has already finished. See docs/batch-kpis-prediction-readiness-review.md for the full analysis.
